title: 【青丝怨08】共生依赖
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“舒坦！”

刑侦大队办公室里，副队长王猛看着那份供词大喜。

憋屈了三个多月，可算是让他们出了这口窝囊气。

王建军也朝着孟长离竖起一个大拇指：“才过去一天就抓到凶手破了案，小孟教授，你就是这个！”

孟长离勾唇浅笑：“我只是通过我的专业提供了一些建议，破案主要还是靠你们。”

王建军摆摆手：“你太谦虚了！要不是有你在，我们现在没准还被蒙在鼓里呢！”

刘浩强也附和：“可不是嘛？王兵那老小子长得太老实了，任谁第一眼看了都不觉得他会杀人，还是多亏了你。”

孟长离……

孟长离没话了。

只能在一句句夸夸夹缝中生存，一味地微笑点头嗯。

一群本应是她叔伯爷爷辈的人对着她夸，压力很大的好不好？

郭保国的思绪从供词里抽离，抬起头：“小孟啊，你刚才在走之前，为什么会那么问？”

出审讯室的时候他走在后面，自然也将王兵的表情尽收眼底，那明显是感到意外和秘密被拆穿的反应。

孟长离摸了摸鼻子：“其实我一开始也只是想诈他来着……从心理学的角度来讲，王兵是明显的共生依赖型人格以及情感客体错位。从小母亲的角色缺位，三观认知都源于父亲。他的养父于他而言，就是心里那座唯一的山。养父去世后，他心里的‘山’就自然而然变成了妻子。”

“我没听懂！不是说媳妇儿嘛，跟他爹又有啥关系啊？”王建军听得云里雾里，不等她说完就迫不及待地举起手提问：

“而且孟教授你之前做那个侧写的时候，不是说那个扎麻花辫的女人对他很重要吗？如果是这样的话，他为什么还要杀他媳妇儿？”

孟长离：“之所以说妻子对他重要，是因为那是他人生中深度接触的第一位女性。在他眼里，只有他妻子的穿衣打扮、说话方式各方面才是一个正常女性应该有的。所以他一直用妻子的喜好，去规训他的女儿，鞭挞其他女性。”

“他的妻子于他而言不是爱人、不是伴侣，而是父亲的替代品，一个用于陪伴他和给予他依靠的存在。但由于出现了变数——他的妻子难产了。所以在失去这座‘山’和重新拥有一座新的山之间，他宁愿选择了后者，也不要让自己再次落单。”

当然还有不可说的一点——

她在破棚里看到的第一帧画面。

Page (1/3)

"Comfortable!"

In the office of the Criminal Investigation Brigade, deputy captain Wang Meng was overjoyed when he saw the confession.

After being depressed for more than three months, they felt so helpless.

Wang Jianjun also gave a thumbs up to Meng Changli: "It's only been a day since I caught the murderer and solved the case. Professor Meng, you are the one!"

Meng Changli raised his lips and smiled slightly: "I just provided some suggestions through my profession. It is mainly up to you to solve the case."

Wang Jianjun waved his hand: "You are too humble! If it weren't for you, we might still be kept in the dark!"

Liu Haoqiang also echoed: "Isn't that right? That old boy Wang Bing is so honest. No one would think that he would kill anyone at first glance. It's all thanks to you."

Meng Changli...

Meng Changli was speechless.

I can only survive between compliments and compliments, and just smile and nod.

A group of people who were supposed to be her uncles and grandparents were praising her. It was very stressful, okay?

Guo Baoguo's thoughts were separated from the confession and he raised his head: "Xiao Meng, why did you ask that before you left?"

When he left the interrogation room, he walked behind and naturally caught Wang Bing's expression. It was obviously a reaction of surprise and secret being exposed.

Meng Changli touched his nose: "Actually, I just wanted to deceive him at the beginning... From a psychological point of view, Wang Bing has an obvious symbiotically dependent personality and emotional object dislocation. His mother's role has been absent since he was a child, and his three perceptions come from his father. For him, his adoptive father is the only mountain in his heart. After his adoptive father passed away, the 'mountain' in his heart naturally became his wife."

"I don't understand! If you're not talking about your wife, what does it have to do with his father?" Wang Jianjun was confused, and before she could finish speaking, he couldn't wait to raise his hand and ask:

"And Professor Meng, when you did that profile before, didn't you say that the woman with braided braids was very important to him? If that was the case, why did he kill his wife?"

Meng Changli: "The reason why his wife is important to him is because she is the first woman he has had deep contact with in his life. In his eyes, only his wife's dressing and speaking style are what a normal woman should have. So he has always used his wife's preferences to discipline his daughter and flog other women."

"For him, his wife is not a lover or a partner, but a substitute for his father, an existence that accompanies him and provides him with support. But due to a change - his wife had a dystocia. So between losing this 'mountain' and regaining a new one, he would rather choose the latter than let himself be alone again."

Of course there is one more thing that cannot be said——

The first frame she saw in the shed.
